messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD: inference-routing-high-queue (severity: P1) - prod-inference-us-west - > request queue depth 950 (runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-queue)

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident 8472 created, routing to Sam (oncall)

Sam (oncall): Acked the page, looking now. seeing surge from a single client IP range. investigating logs.

Priya (SRE): Sam — if queue is > 900, runbook suggests drain + enable burst-pool. want me to trigger?

Sam (oncall): yes please. I'm seeing 5xx spikes and slow tail latency. starting quick triage: tail /var/log/inference/runtime.log for errors.

Maya (secondary): I didn't get the page until now. PD shows primary unack window expired at +5m and escalated. pinging to coordinate.

Sam (oncall): weird, I acked in Slack but PD web UI shows ack didn't register (maybe mobile DND). I'll keep working but can you confirm burst-pool toggle?

Maya (secondary): toggling burst pool and increasing replica target for model-svc-prod to 6 -> 12. running command:

```
# k8s autoscaler override (one-off)
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/model-svc-prod --replicas=12
redwoodctl capacity set --pool burst-us-west --min 4 --max 10
```

Ops-bot: autoscaler change queued, applying to cluster prod-us-west-1. Expected pod churn ~2-3m.

Priya (SRE): also enabling KV cache bypass for warmup to reduce tail latency (see runbook).

Jordan (product): Heads up — telemetry shows customer-facing 5xxs rising. Anyone see particular model types affected? small-v0 and v1-heavy. Might be model-side mem pressure during load.

Sam (oncall): logs show 'kv-cache OOM' on a subset of hosts. pushing a kill + restart on affected replicas to reclaim.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation policy fired -> secondary routed to Maya after 300s no ack from primary. Manager escalation window at 10m.

Emily (manager): I got the manager page. what's current customer impact and mitigation plan?

Sam (oncall): customer impact: 12% of requests are 5xx globally, mostly from us-west. ETA on replicas coming up ~3m. we've started failing over routing to us-east for traffic from affected ASNs as a short-term mitigation.

Maya (secondary): confirmed replicas scaling. I also opened a temporary routing rule:

```
# quick routing override
redwoodctl route update --from us-west --to us-east --filter asn=AS12345,AS67890 --pct 80
```

Priya (SRE): restarting model-worker on nodes n-prod-05,n-prod-07. observing reduced memory pressure on those nodes.

Emily (manager): Jordan — can you draft a short status page blurb? we should set "degraded performance" and call out region + affected customers. Also decide if we need to notify high-commitment customers directly.

Jordan (product): will draft. question: do we know if this is an exogenous client causing the burst or internal scheduling bug?

Sam (oncall): initial evidence points to an external client retry storm; rate limiting for that ASN was not active. I'm adding a temporary rate limit.

Maya (secondary): added per-ASN rate limit rule for AS12345 => 100rps.

Priya (SRE): after scale + rate-limit, 5xxs dropped to ~3% from 12% in 2m. tail latency 95p also improving.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: secondary did not respond to escalation within 5m, manager escalation fired and Emily acknowledged the manager page.

Emily (manager): I joined the bridge. good containment so far. Sam/Maya/Priya — assign owner for postmortem and timeline?

Sam (oncall): I can own incident. I'll collect timeline and push initial incident report.

Priya (SRE): I'll add mitigation steps and runbook gaps for KV-cache OOM.

Maya (secondary): I'll take follow-up on routing safeguards and per-ASN rate limiting defaults.

Jordan (product): status page draft: "We're experiencing degraded inference performance in US-WEST. We've applied scaling and routing mitigations; customer impact reduced. We're investigating root cause and will provide updates." sending now to #status for approval.

Sam (oncall): quick note: PD notes show primary ack attempt may have failed due to mobile DND + app background throttling. filing a PagerDuty support ticket to avoid missed-acks for future.

Emily (manager): good. if any high-commit customers affected, page me directly and we'll do outreach. otherwise keep this as active incident until stable for 15m.

Ops-bot: autoscaler reports replicas stable at 12 for model-svc-prod. new pods passed readiness probes.

Priya (SRE): metrics look green for us-west ingestion now. moving to monitoring window.

Sam (oncall): timeline notes will include timestamps and commands executed. starting draft in runbook -> https://redwood/incidents/1719999999-draft (will update).

Maya (secondary): recommendation: default per-ASN rate limit + alert when queue grows > 400 for > 60s. filing a follow-up ticket.

Emily (manager): thanks team. keep monitoring and update if anything regresses. planning postmortem tomorrow.

Sam (oncall): closing PD incident once stable for 15m. marking this thread as ongoing until then. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Note: PagerDuty incident 8472 updated: status -> acknowledged; escalations -> manager-acknowledged.
